cues.speaker: junior
cues.text: I just joined an AI agent platform team working on NVIDIA's OpenShell and NeMo stack. I don't know the service mesh, which repos matter, or what depends on what.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Normally, that's two weeks of bugging seniors. And at architect scale, it's an undocumented cross-repo mesh. Parallax turns that tribal knowledge into an explorable reality.

cues.speaker: junior
cues.text: So I ask Parallax: Trace the call stack from our database ORM table up to the client endpoint consuming it.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Watch Nemotron investigate using the code analysis engine's tools. Look at the result: every relationship it claims was checked by the engine. Verified. Contradicted. Unverifiable. The model doesn't decide what's true; the engine does.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Click Show on map, and it takes us directly to the architecture backing the answer.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Now I want the whole picture. Repos, services, endpoints, down to the actual functions. Everything is loaded on demand, so even massive monorepos scale smoothly.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Solid lines are proven by static analysis. Dashed lines are inferred, fainter the less sure the engine is. Parallax never promotes a guess to a fact.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Click any endpoint to see who consumes it across repos, and how confident we are.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Before code ships: what does this pull request break downstream? The engine determines the blast radius and severity, while Nemotron explains the impact finding by finding—no invented regressions, zero hallucinations.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Under the hood: Nemotron Super plans the investigation and Lightning handles fast tool execution through Nebius Token Factory. Every tool call and prompt version is saved to the audit log. The entire platform runs on Nebius.

cues.speaker: architect
cues.text: Knowledge locked in people's heads, made navigable and verifiable. That's Parallax: if it's in your org's code, it can guide you.
